guidance.promptSnippet: Ask a concise structured question when a material decision is missing
promptGuidelines: Group necessary questions into one call. Provide concise labeled options; recommend the first when appropriate. The tool adds its own free-text option. Proceed with reasonable defaults for routine choices.
guidance.description: Ask the user grouped questions when a material requirement or preference is missing. Supply 2–3 concise options per question; the tool adds free text. Put a recommended option first. Never author Other/Type something options.
